bio.text: Mike Thompson represents California's 4th Congressional District in the U.S. House and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
Thompson was born in St. Helena, California, in 1951, and served in the U.S. Army from 1969 to 1972.
Thompson earned bachelor's and master's degrees from California State University, Chico, in 1982 and 1996.
Thompson previously worked as a professor and winery owner, and served in the California State Senate from 1990 to 1998.
